transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling StarTel, Jason speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We've had three outages this month. We're seriously considering switching providers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can pull up your incident log and escalate this. May I confirm your business name?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Yes, I see the incidents. Have you already discussed this with tech support?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. They said they'd investigate, but nothing changed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I'll escalate this directly to our network engineering team and propose a service credit for the last month. Also, we can enable proactive monitoring alerts for your circuit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, send me the SLA documentation and credit note.
